scientific_integrity: The known chromatic polynomial state counts are credited as prior work; complete finite proof uses two distinct executable graph enumerations, with all-source shortest paths independently checked. No outside auditor or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite result only for the eight-vertex Wagner graph and k=3,4; no general ladder theorem or mixing-time result. Earlier July 2005 primary report has month-level date without an exact public day; 2013-02-14 is the earliest precisely day-dated selected original arXiv posting. The 1972 original enumeration paper was not read in full and historical priority has residual risk.
title: The Wagner graph recolouring threshold and its uniform twelve-move eccentricity
